edges.reason: constructor calls external Uniswap factory createPair.
lock performs unchecked now + time addition.
_transfer calls swapAndLiquify which makes external calls.
_transfer invokes external-call path before final token state update.
swapTokensForEth makes external Uniswap router call.
addLiquidity makes external Uniswap router call.
_transfer from parameter flows into transfer logic.
_transfer to parameter flows into transfer logic.
_transfer amount parameter flows into transfer logic.
local takeFee controls fee removal in _transfer.
local contractTokenBalance controls swap trigger in _transfer.
local half is used for token swap in swapAndLiquify.
local otherHalf is used for liquidity in swapAndLiquify.
local initialBalance captures pre-swap ETH balance.
local newBalance is derived from post-swap ETH balance.

normalization_plan.reason: _transfer address parameter from flows into internal transfer logic.
_transfer address parameter to flows into internal transfer logic.
_transfer amount parameter flows into internal transfer logic.
swapAndLiquify contractTokenBalance parameter drives swap and liquidity split.
swapTokensForEth tokenAmount parameter is swapped through Uniswap.
addLiquidity tokenAmount parameter is added as liquidity.
addLiquidity ethAmount parameter is sent as liquidity value.
lock time parameter is added to now to set _lockTime.
setMaxTxPercent maxTxPercent parameter computes _maxTxAmount.
setTaxFeePercent taxFee parameter writes _taxFee.
setLiquidityFeePercent liquidityFee parameter writes _liquidityFee.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled enabled flag writes swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
excludeFromReward account parameter is excluded from rewards.
includeInReward account parameter is re-included into rewards.
excludeFromFee account parameter is excluded from fees.
includeInFee account parameter is included in fees.
approve spender parameter is passed to _approve.
approve amount parameter is passed to _approve.
increaseAllowance spender parameter updates allowance.
increaseAllowance addedValue parameter updates allowance.
decreaseAllowance spender parameter updates allowance.
decreaseAllowance subtractedValue parameter updates allowance.
deliver tAmount parameter is used to reduce reflection supply.
transfer recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
transferFrom sender parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
transferFrom recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
transferFrom amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer and _approve.
local takeFee controls whether fees are removed during transfer.
local contractTokenBalance determines swap-and-liquify trigger.
local overMinTokenBalance gates the swapAndLiquify call.
local half is the token amount swapped for ETH.
local otherHalf is the token amount used for liquidity.
local initialBalance captures the pre-swap contract ETH balance.
local newBalance is the ETH received from the swap.
